    const int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    const int C = 12;

    vector<vector<array<long long, 5>>> adj(50 * T + 2);
    auto add_edge = [&](int a, int b, long long cap=1, long long p=0) {
        adj[a].push_back({b, 0, cap, 0, p});
        adj[b].push_back({a, 0, 0, 0, -p});
    };

    int sink = n * T + 1;

    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        int a;

        add_edge(source, a, 1);
    }

    for (int t = 0; t < T; t++) {
        add_edge(1 + t * n, sink, INF);
        if (t > 0) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                add_edge(i + (t - 1) * n, i + t * n, INF, c);
            }
        }
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
        int a, b;
        cin >> a >> b;
        for (int j = 0; j < C; j++) {
            int cost = (j + 1) * (j + 1) - j * j;
            for (int t = 1; t < T; t++) {
                add_edge(a + (t - 1) * n, b + t * n, 1, cost * d + c);
                add_edge(b + (t - 1) * n, a + t * n, 1, cost * d + c);
            }
        }
    }

    long long total_cost = 0, flow = 0;
    vector<long long> dist(adj.size()), potential(adj.size()), parent(adj.size());
    vector<bool> in_queue(adj.size());

    auto min_cost_flow = [&](int s, int t) {
        long long flow = 0, cost = 0;
        while (true) {
            fill(dist.begin(), dist.end(), LLONG_MAX);
            dist[s] = 0;
            queue<int> q;
            q.push(s);
            in_queue.assign(adj.size(), false);
            in_queue[s] = true;

            while (!q.empty()) {
                int u = q.front(); q.pop();
                in_queue[u] = false;
                for (int i = 0; i < (int)adj[u].size(); i++) {
                    auto& e = adj[u][i];
                    if (e[2] > 0 && dist[u] + e[4] + potential[u] - potential[e[0]] < dist[e[0]]) {
                        dist[e[0]] = dist[u] + e[4] + potential[u] - potential[e[0]];
                        parent[e[0]] = u;
                        parent[i] = i;
                        if (!in_queue[e[0]]) {
                            q.push(e[0]);
                            in_queue[e[0]] = true;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            if (dist[t] == LLONG_MAX) break;

            for (int i = 0; i < (int)adj.size(); i++) {
                if (dist[i] < LLONG_MAX) potential[i] += dist[i];
            }

            long long df = LLONG_MAX;
            for (int u = t; u != s; u = parent[u]) {
                auto& e = adj[parent[u]][0];
                for (auto& e2 : adj[parent[u]]) {

                        df = min(df, e2[2]);
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }

            for (int u = t; u != s; u = parent[u]) {
                for (auto& e2 : adj[parent[u]]) {
                    if (e2[0] == u && e2[2] > 0) {
                        e2[2] -= df;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                for (auto& e2 : adj[u]) {
                    if (e2[0] == parent[u]) {
                        e2[2] += df;
                        cost += df * e2[4];
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            flow += df;
        }
        return make_pair(flow, cost);
    };

    auto result = min_cost_flow(source, sink);
    long long flow_value = result.first;
    long long total_price = result.second;

    if (flow_value != k) {
        cout << -1 << "\n";
    } else {

    }
